title: The BuddyForms WordPress plugin before 2.10.1 does not properly verify ownership before deleting guest-uploaded…
description: The BuddyForms WordPress plugin versions before 2.10.1 contain a vulnerability where the plugin does not properly verify ownership before deleting guest-uploaded attachments. This flaw allows unauthenticated attackers to permanently delete media files uploaded by other unauthenticated visitors.
